name: Oni
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot bracers/arms; Price 32,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This tattoo is most often rendered with the image of a red-skinned oni on one arm.

The tattoo’s owner gains the following:

Continual: fire resistance 10
2/day: Gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 5 minutes each time.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, bull’s strength, resist energy; Cost 16,000 gp.
